note: Oregon requires every city and county to file a Post-Acknowledgement Plan Amendment notice with DLCD for any comprehensive plan amendment or zone change, and DLCD must publish proposals and adoptions weekly — precisely the instrument an Oregon data center rezoning uses, captured statewide before the vote.
